entries: What did you mean, the branches die?
你说「枝条死去」，是什么意思？
We might have overloaded his tiny brain.
我们可能把他那小脑子烧坏了。
This will make quite a tale.
这能成就一段相当精彩的故事。
Despite 'its' fearsome appearance, it is not like the other monsters we have fought.
尽管「它」外表骇人，它并不像我们交手过的其他怪物。
You have some explaining to do.
I sense something about him. He's different somehow. The way he speaks is changing.
我感觉到了他身上的一点什么。他有些不一样。他说话的方式在变。
We will surely meet again. Perhaps answers will come.
我们一定还会再见。也许到时会有答案。
